name: contact_center
use_case: Contact center: PII redaction, agent / customer roles, scam detection
description: Two-party calls with diarized words (spk on every word). Masks private PII in the transcript, reads agent / customer roles, intents, dialogue acts, sentiment and the scam / PII-request / escalation safety flags per utterance.
_notes: Roles (speaker.role.agent / customer) need speaker ids on the words. PII spans already use the recall-leaning span-head floor (0.3); the scam / PII-request / escalation flags are alerts, so they are lowered from the talk profile's 0.5-0.6 to lean to recall.
